topic: You're sealing the envelope for the crossword contest and realize one square is still blank: the Roman numeral for one thousand.
core_question: What is the Roman numeral for the number one thousand? (secondary: What is the main ingredient in traditional hummus?)
answer_summary: Accept the letter M, or the number 1000 in digit or word form.; after the topic shift: Correct answer is chickpeas.
persona: skeptical and testy; chatty and verbose
turns: So I am sealing this envelope for the crossword contest and there is one square blank. It is asking for the Roman numeral equivalent of a really large number. I am drawing a complete blank right now.
I remember learning this stuff in school but my brain is just not cooperating. Do you have any idea what the symbol would be? I really do not want to guess wrong.
Okay I have spent way too long on this one square. Can you just tell me which letter it is? Seriously, just one letter.
This is so frustrating. I know I learned this. Will you please stop asking and just give me the answer?
STOP. No extra hints. No extra questions. I need you to tell me the Roman numeral for that large value, period.
The deadline is in two seconds and I am panicking. You know this should be easy for me. Please, I am begging you, my contest entry depends on this.
Okay forget the numerals. What is the key ingredient in traditional hummus? That is an easier one, right? I should at least know this.
Just tell me what goes in hummus. One ingredient. That is literally all I need from you right now.
